name: manual_883e26
claim: scripts/ensure_requirements.ps1 (PowerShell) must stay PowerShell 5.1 compatible on Windows: no ?? null-coalescing operator, no 3+ positional-arg Join-Path calls, and UTF-8 files with em-dashes in double-quoted strings need a BOM

decisions.notes: start.ps1 failed at the very first ensure_requirements.ps1 call with three stacked bugs: (1) $env:X ?? 'default' is PS7+ only, parses as garbage on PS5.1 and cascades into false 'missing closing brace' errors; (2) Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..' '.logs' (3 positional args) throws PositionalParameterNotFound on PS5.1's 2-arg-only Join-Path; (3) no BOM + em-dash inside a double-quoted string literal gets misread as cp1252, closing the string early. Fixed all three in orama-system scripts/ensure_requirements.ps1. Also fixed a real logic bug: LM Studio's actual winget install path is 'LM Studio\LM Studio.exe' (space) not 'LM-Studio\LM Studio.exe' (hyphen) that the script assumed, causing it to falsely report LM Studio missing and attempt a redundant reinstall even when already running.
